# CI quarantine list (surefire excludesFile).
#
# Currently EMPTY, and the intent is that it stays that way.
#
# NOTE: ASCII only. Surefire reads this file with the platform default charset,
# so non-ASCII characters break it with "Failed to load list from file: Input length = 1".
#
# This file exists for one situation: tests that were ALREADY RED before CI existed,
# where leaving them in would have made CI red from day one. A permanently red CI is
# the same as no CI, because real regressions drown in the noise.
#
# It is NOT a place to park new failures. A newly failing test is a regression -- fix
# the code. Every entry must carry its root cause and the condition for deleting it.
#
# Usage: mvn test -Dsurefire.excludesFile=<repo-root>/.github/known-test-failures.txt
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# History: the six classes originally quarantined here have all been fixed and
# their entries removed. Kept as a short record of what the causes turned out to be.
#
#   MultiInstanceStatusQueryConsistencyPropertyTest (engine, 2F)
#     taskService.createTaskQuery() was left unstubbed and returned null; the NPE was
#     swallowed by the controller's catch and surfaced as success=false, which read
#     like a status-consistency bug.
#
#   ConfigurationValidationPropertyTest (platform-common, 1F)
#     The "critically invalid" fixture only violated @NotNull on jwtSecretKey, and
#     ConfigurationValidator.isCriticalViolation() classifies by propertyPath keywords
#     and *English* message text. On a non-English JVM the localised message missed
#     that match, the violation was filed as a warning, and no exception was thrown.
#
#   ExternalConfigurationLoadingPropertyTest (platform-common, 4F)
#     SecurityConfig.jwtSecretKey gained @NotNull after these tests were written; no
#     generator or fixture supplied it, so the closing validate() always failed.
#
#   UserPropertyTest (platform-security, 3E)
#     @Size bounds characters, BCrypt's 72-byte limit is bytes. jqwik generates
#     non-ASCII, and 50 CJK characters is 150 bytes.
#
#   TravelExpenseIdempotencyPropertyTest, TravelExpenseDependencyErrorPropertyTest
#     (user-portal, 2E) -- deleted. They asserted on SQL under
#     deploy/init-scripts/14-travel-expense-reimbursement/, which a804c1f55 removed as
#     dead n8n code. That commit deleted a sibling test for the same reason and simply
#     missed these two.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
